patch_description: Replace the per-qubit parameterized linear-chain ansatz with an interleaved hypercube brick-wall design. The 12 CZ edges of the 3-cube are decomposed into 3 disjoint perfect matchings, with shared RY rotations inserted between each matching. This creates a more expressive entangling structure while keeping parameters fully shared across qubits (7 unique params per block = 44 total) to ensure strong generalization, similar to the best-performing prior design but with interleaved rotation layers for better expressivity.
